text.description_html:
RK International CP-3710, 3" Rustic Cabinet Door Pull

When we look at these rustic cabinet pulls, we imagine a house on the prairie; but that is probably just us. We love the country feel of these RK International cabinet door pulls. They are not shabby chic, they are just chic. Measuring 3 inches center to center, it is great for use in the kitchen on cabinets, on the desk in the office, or even to replace the one falling off your grandmother's china cabinet. Choose from the 5 available finishes to really make them standout where ever you choose to use them.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-3710 Traditional Smooth Pull with Lines:

  • Material: Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 3-1/2"
  • Width: 5/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
